providers.label: OpenAI
providers.notes: Official OpenAI API. $env injection expects the full header value, e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY='Bearer <key>'.

providers.label: Anthropic (Claude)
providers.notes: Anthropic Messages API (Claude models). Also the protocol claude-code speaks natively.

providers.label: Google Gemini
providers.notes: Native Gemini API. An OpenAI-compatible surface also exists at /v1beta/openai (models.dev records both).

providers.label: OpenRouter
providers.notes: Aggregator over many providers; single key, OpenAI-compatible.

providers.label: z.ai (GLM, global)
providers.notes: GLM pay-as-you-go endpoint. env var name per models.dev: ZHIPU_API_KEY (vendor docs also accept ZAI_API_KEY).

providers.label: z.ai GLM Coding Plan
providers.notes: Subscription (Coding Plan) endpoint; quota comes from the plan, not pay-as-you-go credits. Speaks the Anthropic protocol for coding tools (OpenAI protocol also supported per vendor quick-start).

providers.label: Zhipu (bigmodel.cn, CN)
providers.notes: China mainland GLM endpoint. A dedicated coding endpoint exists at /api/coding/paas/v4 (models.dev: zhipuai-coding-plan).

providers.label: Moonshot (Kimi, OpenAI protocol)
providers.notes: Kimi OpenAI-compatible surface. CN mainland endpoint: https://api.moonshot.cn/v1 (models.dev: moonshotai-cn).

providers.label: Kimi Anthropic protocol
providers.notes: Kimi's Anthropic-compatible Messages surface for Claude-protocol coding tools.

providers.label: MiniMax
providers.notes: models.dev records the Anthropic-protocol surface (token plan shares it). CN mainland: https://api.minimaxi.com/anthropic/v1.

providers.label: Qwen Token Plan
providers.notes: Alibaba token-plan (Qwen subscription) endpoint, OpenAI-compatible; the second domain is the CN variant (models.dev: alibaba-token-plan / alibaba-token-plan-cn).

providers.label: GitHub Copilot
providers.notes: OpenAI-compatible surface for Copilot subscribers; token exchange requirements vary - verify against your account before relying on it.

providers.label: Ollama (local)
providers.notes: Local runtime template (no keyEnv). The OpenAI-compatible surface is <base>/v1; the service upstream points at the runtime root so paths compose. Consumer port deliberately differs from the runtime's own 11434.
providers.source: https://models.dev/api.json (ollama-cloud sibling documents the API shape; runtime port per ollama docs)

providers.label: LM Studio (local)
providers.notes: Local runtime template (no keyEnv). Requires 'Enable CORS/serve on local network' off; server default port 1234.
